text:
maya_cs: Heads-up — Averna onboarding health: P95 latency creeping from 320ms -> 450ms over the last 48h, throughput stable but token cost up 18%. Renewal in ~8 weeks, flagged as medium risk if UX doesn't improve. Proposing a quick pilot: int8 quant + compact model swap for tail requests + split routing (low-latency vs cost) for 2 weeks. Thoughts?

jordan_se: thanks for flagging. can you paste a sample of the tail traces? any specific prompts that hit the long config?

maya_cs: pasting a trimmed trace — users hitting long instructions and multi-turn context. not full customer data, just shapes:
```
request_id: x7b2
seq_len: 2048
model: rdm-large-v1
resp_time_ms: 472
path: hosted->fallback-dedicated
```

li_eng: quick reaction: int8 likely safe for generation here if we limit to prefix-cached requests + smaller kv cache retention. model-swap idea: route >1500 tokens to rdm-compact-v1 with same tokenizer, keep <1500 on rdm-large-v1. reduces avg token cost ~22% in our sims.

sam_csm: from a renewal POV we should surface perf delta and a sample SLO dashboard for the account. can design a 1-pager for Averna execs showing before/after. also want to capture user feedback during pilot (small in-app survey?).

jordan_se: agree. li, can you run a dry-run sim on their production prompt-set (anonymized) and share latency/cost table? target: P95 < 350ms or at least -20% latency and -15% cost.

li_eng: will run sim today. quick note on routing: implement split by token-count + header tag so we can A/B flag. config snippet we can use in routing rules:
```yaml
routing_rule:
  - if: request.tokens > 1500
    route: rdm-compact-v1
    fallback: rdm-large-v1
  - else:
    route: rdm-large-v1
```

ops-bot: deployment-check: no active canaries in customer namespace. recommended window: low-traffic hours (02:00-05:00 UTC). autoscale policy will allow 2x burst.

maya_cs: good — i'll ping Averna PM to schedule pilot kickoff and the UX survey. sam, i'll need that 1-pager by EOD Friday so their renewal exec sees it before next touch.

sam_csm: ok on the 1-pager. i'll draft with the key metrics: latency P50/P95, token cost per 1k reqs, error rate, and subjective user feedback. will include rollback criteria.

jordan_se: after li posts sim results, i'll add a short playbook: canary steps, smoke checks, rollback commands. keep change small (routing + quant flags), avoid model weight swap unless sims look good.

maya_cs: thanks all. last item — capture customer feedback: adding a small survey post-pilot with 3 quick Qs and an open field. will share draft. tagging @sam_csm @li_eng for their parts. :rocket:
